notes.title: Huge update turns Steam sandbox game into a mix of Roadcraft and State of Decay
notes.notes:
Sandbox games live and die by how much stuff you can do. They can be lean or expansive, massive or tight, but each must offer multiple approaches to the open word and its challenges. Games like Roadcraft and State of Decay manage this well, though they represent opposite ends of the sandbox spectrum. A vehicle-based survival game called The Front just got a huge update, which allows players to customize vehicles, opening up almost endless possibilities.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The Front Major Update Now Live — Vehicle Assembly Gameplay Trailer Released
notes.notes: [p]At 8:00 UTC on July 14, The Front officially launched a major update! The core feature of this update is the introduction of the Vehicle Assembly system, allowing players to freely build and customize combat vehicles to create highly personalized war machines that can adapt flexibly to different battlefield environments and enemies. At the same time, we’ve released a brand-new gameplay trailer that fully showcases the entire experience from assembly to combat. We invite everyone to watch, like, and share it with your friends![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/ZxsJ92De7gQ"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Currently, [i]The Front[/i] is still in Early Access. We aim to continuously expand the game’s building boundaries and tactical possibilities through deeper and more flexible system gameplay.[/p][p] [/p][p]At the same time, to celebrate this update, we’re launching a limited-time [b]20% discount from July 14 to July 28[/b]. We invite everyone to seize this opportunity and join the world of [i]The Front[/i]![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/1a282560320f22088beff83ca39f81806377f4d7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Vehicle Assembly System Live — Build Freely, Fight Anytime[/b][/h3][p]In this update, the highly anticipated Vehicle Assembly system makes its official debut, showcased in detail through a live gameplay trailer. Players can freely combine chassis, engines, weapons, armor modules, and more on the Assembly Platform to build uniquely styled and highly functional custom war machines.[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/23dc85bc91a1523834a66cce0166b206c520edde.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once assembled, vehicles can be deployed immediately. The effects of different parts on core attributes like speed, firepower, and defense are highly intuitive. Even small adjustments can lead to vastly different combat experiences. Currently, the system offers over 40 available parts, all obtainable through exploration and combat.[/p][p] [/p][p]To ensure gameplay balance, we’ve incorporated restrictions such as weight capacity, power consumption, and mounting points into the system. These encourage players to make strategic trade-offs during assembly, preventing imbalanced setups caused by excessive stacking.[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/00171fad0c794bdba39e5bbbe8528ce9789eb675.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]Black Sun Obelisks Unlocked [/b][/h3][p]We’ve also added brand-new dungeon content in this update — seven “Black Sun Obelisk” exploration zones are now open. Each zone features unique terrain layouts and exclusive boss mechanics, with overall difficulty designed for the late-game stage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/2e63fbdc1429d4768156ed6ab9f547f182e6bb8d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The newly introduced “Vehicle Monsters” serve as a special enemy type, providing a real combat testing ground for players’ custom-built war machines, and further strengthening the synergy between vehicle construction and combat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/c7ab03f588de724e858846c0a7eaed70b25ebe32.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, dungeon challenge drops and progression pacing have been redesigned to create a closed-loop cycle of “challenge dungeons → obtain materials → assemble war machines → advance progression,” adding more depth and a greater sense of accomplishment to the overall gameplay flow.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Worldbuilding Progresses, Core Experience Refined[/b][/h3][p]The lore surrounding the “Black Sun Project” has been further expanded in this update. Players will gradually uncover the secrets of the Empire’s Ether experiments through exploring zones, unlocking keys, and gathering data. Although the main storyline is still in its early stages, the core narrative framework is taking shape, and we plan to continue expanding key story elements in future updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/a850be92426f480ddc337399bb2751d441945c0e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]At the same time, we have optimized multiple core systems, including complex terrain loading, AI behavior logic, character model performance, and UI interactions. While these improvements are not the main highlights of this update, we believe they bring significant value in enhancing overall smoothness and user experience.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]Expanding the Depth of Building × Combat Around the Assembly Core[/b][/h3][p]We plan to continue expanding the core gameplay of “Vehicle Assembly” in upcoming updates. Currently in development are flying vehicles, spider-claw war machines, and a customization paint system. Our goal is to gradually shape “free assembly + strategic combat” into the main gameplay path of [i]The Front[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p]We welcome everyone to join the world of [i]The Front[/i] and experience the fun of free assembly. Thank you all for your continued attention and support — we will keep refining the content and bringing new surprises![/p]

notes.title: The Front – July Major Update Preview: Build and Customize Your Vehicles!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Rebels![/p][p]First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt thanks to every one of you fighting alongside us in this world. Whether you’ve been here since the earliest test days or just joined our ranks recently, you’re the driving force that keeps us pushing forward and improving. Your feedback, suggestions, and patient support mean the world to us — and we never take it for granted.[/p][p] [/p][p]Today, we’re thrilled to share some exciting news — [b]The Front[/b] will receive a [b]massive free update this July![/b] This update will roll out in Standard Mode, introducing the brand-new [b]Vehicle Assembly[/b] core feature, seven new [b]Black Sun Obelisks[/b] to explore, and a host of improvements focused on performance, onboarding, gameplay flow, and overall controls.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/dc6e233b8d0bad8a4f5662977d8fe7f3abb49d8a.jpg"][/img]Some of these additions have been in the works for a long time, while others come directly from your suggestions and wishes. We’re deeply grateful for your patience and for walking this still-evolving road with us. We hope this update marks a brand-new starting point for The Front to keep moving forward — and to become even better, together with you.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Vehicle Assembly Arrives — Build Freely, Define Your Own Way to Fight[/b][/h2][p]In this post-apocalyptic world, vehicles shouldn’t all look the same — and they shouldn’t be limited to what the system dictates.[/p][p] [/p][p]In the new update, [b]Vehicle Assembly[/b] will make its official debut. It’s not just a simple feature — it’s a complete system built around freedom of construction, performance trade-offs, and expanded combat possibilities. Our hope is that you’ll truly start from scratch and craft your very own apocalypse war machine with your own hands.[/p][p] [/p][p]To support this, we’ve added a dedicated workbench called the [b]Vehicle Modification Platform[/b]. Here, you can build and customize your vehicles. The platform requires connection to the power grid and a stable power supply to operate, following the same logic as other electrical devices.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/cb41573e3c9deb400eba5d7c54b211b5fd210293.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]1.Vehicle Composition and Component Types[/b][/h3][p]In the assembly system, a complete vehicle consists of three main structural components：[/p][list][*][p]Basic Structure[b]:[/b] Composed of the chassis, frame, and engine — all three are essential, determining the vehicle’s overall framework and performance limits[/p][/*][*][p]Mountable Modules[b]:[/b] Including weapons, armor, and support components, used to enhance offense, defense, and tactical capabilities[/p][/*][*][p]Exterior Paint: Will eventually support customizations like painting and graffiti (not yet implemented in this update)[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]This update will introduce over [b]40 buildable parts[/b] in the initial release, covering the following:[/p][list][*][p]Chassis[b]:[/b] The load-bearing skeleton. Differences between wheeled and tracked types affect mobility and overall size[/p][/*][*][p]Frame: Determines the overall vehicle frame and mounting expansion capabilities[/p][/*][*][p]Engine: Provides power and electricity output — the “heart” of the vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons: Various types of firepower systems that can be mounted for offensive output[/p][/*][*][p]Armor: Enhances the vehicle’s overall defense, boosting battlefield survivability[/p][/*][*][p]Utility: Includes Storage Chest, Gas Can, and Battery to enhance vehicle functionality and sustain combat endurance[/p][/*][/list][p]Vehicle parts come in different quality tiers and can be obtained by defeating vehicle NPCs or exploring areas like the [b]Black Sun Obelisk[/b]. All parts are assembled modularly, allowing you to build a war machine with controllable performance and a style that’s entirely your own.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/124c2638394e0ac0ecbe058baec8e1d30d5e27d7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]2.Assembly Rules and Mounting System[/b][/h3][p]Free assembly doesn’t mean no rules. To maintain construction logic and combat balance, vehicle assembly will follow these core mechanics:[/p][list][*][p]Basic Constraints: Includes weight capacity, total power, and part quantity limits[/p][/*][*][p]Mounting Point Compatibility System:[/p][/*][/list][p](1)    Mounting points on the frame and parts must match in shape and structure[/p][p](2)    Universal components (such as the frame and armor) can display varied appearances[/p][p](3)    Special components (such as engines, weapons, and utility modules) have no restrictions on installation locations[/p][p](4)    Parts that don’t match or exceed limits cannot be mounted, preventing misaligned assembly[/p][p] [/p][p]The entire assembly process unfolds in real time within the open world, with every step instantly reflected in the environment—letting you directly experience the satisfaction of building your vehicle from parts to a complete war machine.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]3.Vehicle Repair System[/b][/h3][p]When a vehicle is not completely destroyed, players can use the Vehicle Repair Station to fix it by consuming repair materials.
Additionally, removed components can be sent to their respective workbenches for individual repairs, reducing resource waste and extending the vehicle’s lifespan.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]4.Future Expansion Preview[/b][/h3][p]Future updates will introduce [b]Mechanical Claws[/b] and [b]Flying Vehicles[/b]. Additionally, [b]Vehicle Painting[/b] and [b]Graffiti Systems[/b] are already planned for development, allowing you to customize the appearance of metal parts—making your war machine not only practical but uniquely yours.[/p][p] [/p][p]We can’t wait to see the first battle vehicle you build that truly belongs to you.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Black Sun Obelisks Unveiled — Seven Strongholds + All-New Boss Challenges[/b][/h2][p]Exploration content is also getting a major expansion. This new update will add seven [b]Black Sun Obelisks[/b] — each a distinct fortress with unique environments, serving as milestone challenge points to test players’ skills.[/p][p] [/p][p]Boss challenges will range from the entry-level Forlorn Clown to the survival- and damage-testing Crazed Eye and Brianman. Each boss features unique skills and tactical mechanics.[/p][p] [/p][p]Additionally, monster distribution, loot rewards, and stronghold pacing have all been systematically optimized. We’ve also introduced a new enemy type — vehicle monsters — to put your war machine’s strength to the ultimate test.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/f67d2e1d9d46ad610a2b42a14d4b54040174240f.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Lore Reforged — The Black Sun Project Emerges[/b][/h2][p]We’ve also taken this opportunity to review and expand the overall lore and background of The Front:[/p][list][*][p]How the Empire’s lust for the primordial energy “Ether” led it down the path of tyranny and destruction？[/p][/*][*][p]Why the launch of the “Black Sun Project” triggered the undead outbreak, plunging all of human civilization into the abyss？[/p][/*][*][p]How players, as members of the future resistance, travel through time to the eve of the launch？[/p][/*][/list][p]……[/p][p]These mysteries will be gradually unveiled in the new update. You will take on the role of a visitor from the apocalypse, steadily conquering the Black Sun Obelisks on[b] [/b]Heaven Isle,[b] [/b]unlocking seven key data fragments, and infiltrating the Black Sun Core within the Eagle’s Nest (coming soon) to stop the project from launching.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/cbbd0098e19fbcbbfd5e6a9d5b4faf801b55a3f5.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Multifaceted Improvements: Comprehensive Upgrades to Performance, AI, and Controls[/b][/h2][p]Beyond gameplay updates, this version also brings improvements across multiple dimensions：[/p][list][*][p]Art and underground scene performance optimizations to reduce lag and improve overall smoothness[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced AI behavior and NPC animations for more natural combat actions[/p][/*][*][p]Added new character creation models to expand customization options[/p][/*][*][p]Improved interaction details, such as box status indicators, death markers on the map, and cancelable progress bars[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]We see this update as a fresh starting point. Moving forward, we’ll continue adding new component types and explore gameplay directions like PvP vehicle battles. We know that only through constant iteration and listening to your feedback can this post-apocalyptic world become more vibrant—and a place you’ll want to stay in for the long haul.[/p][p] [/p][p]This July, we welcome you back to the world of The Front.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Front Adventure Mode: Official Launch
notes.notes:
[h2]CHALLENGE POWERFUL BOSSES[/h2]
Introducing Adventure Mode, The Front will undergo maintenance for the 1.2.1 version update during the period of 7:00-9:00 AM UTC on August 23, 2024.

Adventure Mode stands apart from existing game mode, offering a completely new gaming experience:
[olist]
[*]A brand-new combat experience, mission flow, and character progression system.
[*]Varied changes in level design, monster bosses, and unique gameplay mechanics.
[*]Character levels have been removed, and a new method for unlocking tech has been added. By completing missions and hunting down bosses, players will automatically unlock new tech.
[/olist]

This mode supports up to six players simultaneously, so get your friends together and have some fun!

[previewyoutube=YFNbmjdrJHQ;full]< Intro Video>[/previewyoutube]

[h3]New to the game:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added "Adventure Mode" to Main menu. Main menu options for the original game mode, including “Servers”, “Create Dedicated Server”, and “Create Solo/Hosted Game”, will be consolidated into the “Standard Mode” menu.
[*]New tutorial stage and BOSS stages, optimized routes, new watchtowers, residential buildings and more.
[*]New melee weapons, such as machetes, clubs, and hammers, as well as combat features like combo attacks, charged strikes, blocking, and dodging. Additionally, attacks on enemies can result in limb dismemberment.
[*]New “Spark” interface that provides detailed information on bosses. You can also locate bosses using a new portable radar, and earn rewards by defeating them.

notes.title: Major Update for The Front - Adventure Mode and More!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We're thrilled to announce a major update for The Front, introducing a brand-new mode and exciting features that will enhance your gameplay experience. 

Players can access it via Steam library - Right click The Front - Properties - Beta - Beta Participation - Alpha test new adventure mode test. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/a6970f58f1102d6630c778c8c259a9744208f48f.jpg[/img]

Then choose alphatest while launching the game via library:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/60531a880307cd68004f864fdcda967d2c549861.jpg[/img]

If you have discovered any new version related bugs, you can report it via our Discord server discord.gg/playthefront - Alphatest bugs Channel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/43a40d0dec464aa4d18f02cea9d9171b85585c7d.jpg[/img]


[h2]Introducing “Adventure Mode”[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/c45798126c2f07de08ef59446d069e26ae95b61c.jpg[/img]

Adventure Mode is a completely new experience, separate from our existing gameplay modes. It offers a fresh combat system, unique mission flow, and new ways to grow your character. You’ll notice significant changes in level design, boss monsters, and distinctive gameplay features.

In this mode, characters no longer have levels. The tech tree has been revamped, allowing you to unlock new technologies automatically as you complete missions and track down bosses. You can dive into this thrilling adventure with up to five friends by selecting Adventure Mode when creating or joining a server.

[h2]Key Differences from the Open World Mode[/h2]

[h3]- New Tutorial and Challenge Stages:[/h3]

We've introduced new tutorial stages to guide you through the basic game mechanics and combat techniques. The challenge stages, featuring complex environments and formidable bosses, are designed to enhance your combat experience. We’ve also optimized routes and added new structures like watchtowers and houses to enrich the scene effects.

[h3]- Enhanced Melee Combat:[/h3]

Prepare for a more diverse melee combat system! With new weapons like machetes, clubs, and hammers, you can now perform combos, charge attacks, block, and dodge. Consistent attacks on specific body parts of monsters can even lead to limb dismemberment, providing a hyper-realistic battle experience.

[h3]- Task-Based Technology Unlocking with Boss Tracking:[/h3]

In the "Spark" interface, you can now access detailed information on bosses. By activating the "Tracking Mode," you can quickly locate bosses using your portable radar. Defeating bosses, either solo or with your team, will earn you tracking rewards, including specific tech recipes for workbenches, weapons, and vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/df5a527b20c656936e0f9e551245f4bb244d2405.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/dc5059db3b40a39019086bb4b4deb1ab8c9865ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/a10e880f6603ab37448567f65d296840b97bc0c6.jpg[/img]

[h3]- Smarter, More Powerful Bosses:[/h3]

We’ve upgraded the AI and combat behavior of bosses, introducing higher difficulty challenges. New bosses like the Humble Clown, Claw Spider, and Mutant Troll each bring unique attack patterns and skills, making every battle a fresh and strategic challenge. Defeating these bosses will yield high-quality blueprints, encouraging players to keep pushing their limits.

This update is packed with features designed to provide a deeper, more immersive experience. We can’t wait for you to dive into Adventure Mode and explore all the new content.

Stay tuned for the update release this week, and gear up for your next big adventure in The Front!

notes.title: Dev Log 7: Development Plans for March-April
notes.notes:
In the past period, polishing the game and developing new gameplay content have been progressing according to plan, and some new changes will be presented to all players in the coming months.

Now, we'd like to share with you the development plans for the game in March and April, including the expansion of vehicle gameplay, genetic planting gameplay, skin MOD functionality, and more new content and adjustments.

[h2]March Development Plan Update[/h2]
As mentioned in "Dev Log 5," the development team's work on expanding vehicle gameplay will be categorized into two stages: vehicle development and 3D vehicle assembly.

[b]This week, we plan to update the addition of the "vehicle development" feature.[/b] Players can use the new building "3D Printer" (requires power supply) to perform vehicle assembly and reverse craft. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/9ff73efaee1108720c574bb1b2823663aef9482d.png[/img]

[b]Ways to obtain vehicle parts:[/b] killing world bosses/elite NPCs, searching for carbon fiber armament crates, and settling rewards for material reception. There are basic attribute differences between parts.

[b](1) Vehicle Assembly[/b]
Select the necessary core part "Frame" and assemble various types of core and non-core parts based on it to assemble and save new vehicle blueprints.

[b](2) Part Upgrades[/b]
Parts will gain experience during assembly, and when enough experience is gained, they will upgrade automatically. Currently, parts can be upgraded to a maximum of level 60. Each upgrade will yield 2 attribute points, with 1 point randomly added to any attribute of the part during the upgrade, and the other point allocated by the player. There is a maximum limit to the points added to a single attribute.

[b](3) Part Reverse Craft[/b]
By compounding the same parts, the newly synthesized parts will receive permanent improvements in single or multiple attributes.

[b]Special Note:[/b]
[u]Due to the fact that some core part models required for the 3D assembly function are still in production, the current version update will temporarily use 6 existing ground vehicle models as the "Frame" parts (Simple Off-road Vehicle, Light Pickup, "Pegasus" APC, "Hummingbird" AA Gun, "Rhino" Main Battle Tank, "Rebel" Destroyer). There is no difference in the acquisition method for these 6 temporary chassis parts.

After this week's version update, part upgrades, attribute points addition, and reverse operations can be carried out normally. However, due to the above-mentioned situation, dragging parts for assembly will not change the appearance of the vehicle temporarily.

It is expected that the 3D assembly function will be supplemented and added by the end of April, and by then, players can experience the joy of appearance customization. At the same time, upgraded parts can be directly removed and reassembled.[/u]

[h2]April Development Plan Update[/h2]
The following are new content planned to be added in April, as well as some optimization adjustments.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[olist]
[*] 3D Vehicle Assembly Function. Planned to be updated by the end of April. The vehicle assembly gameplay will truly take shape: freely assemble in 3D indoor factory scenes, and see real-time appearance changes when swapping parts, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/210d680d109b122ec6a3810d752ba1ef95b49add.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/a16c7d3b1ed1f800230c258f60f08d2ec987fcf8.png[/img]
[i]Concept Art, actual interface might subject to change[/i]

[*] Skin MOD Function. Players can design their own skins and upload them to the creative workshop using built-in tools.
[*] Genetic Planting Gameplay.
[*] Special NPCs. (1) Special Vehicle NPCs, killing them will drop special vehicle assembly parts; (2) Blast Fiend NPCs, they will charge at players and self-destruct.
[*] Blueprint decomposition and recasting function.
[*] Vehicle Maintenance Factory. Consuming a small amount of items can automatically repair vehicles.
[*] Several buildable caves for housing.
[*] NPC Strongholds. Modeled after player base defense systems, raiding them will yield rich rewards.
[*] Super Battery. Provides power for all electrical appliances within a certain range (does not affect electrical appliances already connected to power lines).
[*] New Equipment. Miner's cap, parachute.
[/olist]

[h2]Adjustments and Optimizations[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Remove the original ground vehicle-related technology lines, they will no longer be manufacturable.
[*] Overhauls at UI Interface.
[*] Adjust map resource distribution, optimize the proportion of mine types, and make mines more accessible for mining vehicles.
[*] All firearms will have more realistic distance damage decay, and will be auto-centered after firing.
[*] Remove NPC loot bag drops during receiving supplies, they will be added to the rewards after complete the supply run.
[*] The "Swift" anti-aircraft system will add extra detection range to prevent shooting through walls.
[*] Various items will display attack and defense values. This value will determine if the item has the ability to cause damages to other items, for example: Iron Spears will not be able to damage tanks. 
[*] Reduce the attack and defense values of individual explosives such as grenades and grenades.
[/olist]

notes.title: Roadmap Adjustment: Introduction of Space-Time Warehouse and Follower Trainer
notes.notes:
We apologize for not meeting the originally scheduled Roadmap (1-3 months after release) in its entirety. We find it necessary to explain to all players the reasons behind this. Additional development content, including the Space-Time Warehouse, Vehicle Customization and Cultivation Gameplay, Gene Planting Gameplay, and Follower Trainer, has disrupted the original plan.

Among these, Vehicle Customization, and Gene Planting Gameplay have been introduced in previous developer logs and are currently under development according to the plan. We will keep updating the development details with you in the future. Below is a brief overview of the Space-Time Warehouse and Follower Trainer.

[h2]Space-Time Warehouse [/h2]
The "Space-Time Warehouse" feature is currently in development, allowing players to submit or extract items from the warehouse. There are limitations on the types of items that can be submitted, each with its own quantity limit. Additionally, each item has a corresponding value in space-time points, and the warehouse itself has a point limit. Once this limit is reached, no further item submissions can be made.

The quantity of items and space-time points in the warehouse is account bound, and different server characters created under the same account will share the warehouse items. It's important to note that only official PVP servers allow item operations with the Space-Time Warehouse; items in PVE mode and other unofficial servers are visible but cannot be accessed.

This secure warehouse provides a safety net, allowing players to recover even after losing their possessions. Upon entering a new PVP server, the Space-Time Warehouse offers a shortcut for rapid development. This feature is expected to be added in the February update.

[h2]Follower Trainer[/h2]
A quick-leveling workstation to help follower level up: Place tamed follower into the trainer, and they will gain experience by consuming specific items. This feature is expected to be added in early February.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/c2d3bee1b2de78b1a2b3bb097573b05f7f35116f.png[/img]

[h2]Roadmap Adjustments[/h2]
We will re-schedule the original roadmap and some of the content will be delayed.

[h3]Planned Updates[/h3]
Vehicle Repair Factory, Blast Fiend NPC, Miner's Hat: Expected to be added in February-March.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/911835264323ded17b7fe542b6ee11a70dc6b8e6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/900aed7a949ef14836511803de61350df524ea13.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/b05f6c32f7bb22cc892f61efd6e6431e1bbecd62.png[/img]

[h3]Delayed Development[/h3]
Supercharged Battery (Large Generator Cluster), Elevator, Transformer: Expected to be added in March-April.

[h3]NPCs[/h3]
Tamed NPCs, in addition to having talents, will also possess tech recipes (with some having exclusive tech recipes). Besides the Blast Fiend NPC, no new NPCs will be introduced in the short term. We will focus on enhancing the realistic behavior of NPCs, addressing concerns such as stiff movements and delayed reactions. For example, animals will exhibit behaviors more in line with their natural instincts, with smoother attack animations. Humanoid NPCs will be capable of swimming and launching attacks in water. These "smarter" NPCs are expected to pose new challenges.

[h3]Mod Editing Tool[/h3]
Development of the skin Mod tool is currently underway, with internal testing expected in February.

Our primary focus is on refining the Early Access version to improve game quality. Therefore, regarding gameplay Mod tools, we do not wish to make too many commitments prematurely. Once we got significant improvements of the basic gaming experience, we will be ready to introduce modding support.

notes.title: Dev Log 6: Upcoming Expansion of Follower Talents
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone, and welcome to the latest edition of "The Front" dev log! Today, our focus will be on the expansion of follower talents, which will be introduced in the upcoming version to significantly enrich the roles of followers.

[h2]How to View follower Talents[/h2]
[list]
[*] First, you need to tame the NPC. When an NPC is knocked unconscious, you can see the number of talents it possesses. However, you won't be able to see the talent names, qualities, and effects until the NPC is tamed.
[*] Note: Followers you tamed before the update will not have new talents. Follower level restricts talent unlocking, and talents that are not unlocked won't take effect. In this case, you also won't be able to see the bonus effects.
[/list]

[h2]Functions of follower Talents[/h2]
[list]
[*] The differences in follower talents are reflected in their respective talent effects, covering aspects such as gathering, construction, equipment, light weapons, heavy weapons, alchemy, vehicles, and more.
[*] For example, the "Gathering Modification" talent helps improve the gathering multiplier of gathering tools, the "Durability Enhancement" talent boosts the durability of building items, and the "Barrel Improvement" talent can increase the range of light weapons.
[/list]

[h2]6 Grades of follower Talents[/h2]
[list]
[*] White, Green, Blue, Purple, Orange, Red.
[*] These directly impact the attribute bonuses for talent effects. For the same talent, higher grades provide higher attribute bonuses.
[/list]

[h2]Number of follower Talents[/h2]
[list]
[*] Followers can have up to 5 talents, but it's possible for them to have none.
[*] The probability of each talent appearing varies. Generally, higher-level and rarer NPCs are more likely to have talents with better bonus effects.
[*] We will keep updating the follower’s related gameplay and maintain a balance between all the functions as well. 
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log 5: Genetic Planting, Vehicle Development, Anti-Cheat System, and More
notes.notes:
In this dev log, we will provide updates on the latest developments in our ongoing content development, including progress on vehicle development, genetic planting gameplay, integration of a new anti-cheat system, Christmas events, new skins, and issues to be addressed in the next version.

Please note that the information and concept art mentioned in the dev log about genetic planting gameplay, vehicle customization, etc., are preliminary previews and may subject to change during the development process.

[h2]Genetic Planting Expansion Gameplay[/h2]
We are expanding the planting gameplay by introducing five characteristics to seeds (ultra-low, low, normal, high, ultra-high), in addition to the existing six genetic influencing factors (moisture, light, temperature, fertilization, growth, and yield). After experimentation, players can cultivate seeds with better adaptability and higher yields.

Seeds collected in the wild initially have no characteristics, but they will randomly receive six genetic points after planting. These points are determined by characteristics and genetic combinations, such as low moisture, ultra-low light, high light, high fertilization, low growth speed, and normal yield. The differences in these genetic points often determine the quality of the seeds, with lower-quality seeds possibly having higher requirements for moisture or light but resulting in low yields upon maturity. Not every seed will have all six genetic points simultaneously.

To cultivate seeds, players must meet the basic conditions, which involve planting four mature seeds of the same type in its four adjacent directions. The genetic points will undergo characteristic changes during the "breeding period," indicating the completion of the cultivation process.

The genetic planting gameplay will be introduced soon, and we welcome your feedback and suggestions for gradual improvement based on your experiences.

[h2]Vehicle Development and Customization[/h2]
In the previous dev log, we have outlined our plans for expanding vehicles. The first step, "Vehicle Development," is nearing completion, and the team will internally test the system functionality and validate numerical values in the coming weeks.

The second step will truly implement "Vehicle Customization," which will be a major focus of our work in the coming months. Rest assured, this will not disrupt the current update schedule, and we will continuously address feedback from various communities to improve the gaming experience.

Regarding vehicle customization, we'd like to mention the concept of a "multi-functional assembled vehicle." By connecting two or more vehicle bodies and equipping them with powerful engines and various components, players can create a versatile armed vehicle capable of resource collection, close combat, high defense, and heavy firepower output. The practical design may earn its popularity, but experimenting with unconventional ideas based on settings can also bring unique enjoyment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/2ee630f85d6a555c09c4eee53726ba565d8116b5.png[/img]

[h2]New Anti-Cheat System[/h2]
The integration of the new anti-cheat system is in progress. After integration, we will need some time for testing to ensure a smooth application without issues. If all goes well, the update with the new anti-cheat system is expected to be released by the end of December.

[h2]Christmas Activities[/h2]
Next week, we will kick off the Christmas-themed events. Players can receive surprises from Santa Claus, decorate Christmas trees with various ornaments and more!  

[h2]New Skins[/h2]
Similarly, after the version update next week, 15 sets of new weapon skins will be added to the decoration supply box. Players can craft and use these skins at the weapon crafting station, and they are also available for sale on the Steam market.

[h2]The following issues will also be addressed in the next patch:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Woodpecker anti-aircraft missile launchers unable to lock onto Imperial armed helicopters NPCs and "Infiltrator" Missile Launcher unable to lock onto Imperial tank NPCs. Their perception and attack range will also be reduced.

[*] Adjustment of the monster siege NPC spawn mechanism to reduce instances of monsters being stuck underground. Also, fixing the issue where configured pathfinding navigation does not take effect, reducing instances of monsters getting stuck on terrain or buildings.
[*] For more issue fixes and optimization improvements, please stay tuned for the patch notes of version 1.0.19.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log 4: Vehicle Customization and Progression (12/06/2023)
notes.notes:
In our previous dev log, we mentioned our commitment to enhancing the depth of "vehicle gameplay." Specifically, we are making further efforts to introduce fresh experiences centered around vehicle customization and progression, aiming to uncover more surprises. Due to the extensive nature of the features involved in this development, we have planned a two-step implementation. The good news is that the expansion of vehicle gameplay is progressing smoothly, and this week, we have initiated testing for the first step, focusing on "vehicle progression."

Please note that the gameplay descriptions and concept images mentioned in this dev log are not final versions. There may be adjustments and changes before the final integration into the game. We encourage you to share your ideas and feedback to help us achieve the desired effects more effectively.

[h2]Vehicle Progression[/h2]
According to our current plan, the multidimensional attributes of vehicle components determine the vehicle's strength. These attributes are influenced by three factors: component upgrades, component forging, and reverse engineering. To upgrade a component, it must first be installed on the vehicle. Similar to character progression, components gain experience through various actions, automatically leveling up when enough experience is accumulated, resulting in changes to the component's attribute values.

Component forging involves using specific materials to forge designated attribute entries, increasing the corresponding attribute values. The number of forging attempts is closely related to component upgrades. 

As for reverse engineering, it refers to creating new components by scanning and analyzing existing ones. The new components inherit the original attributes, with a chance of alteration, reduction, or enhancement based on probabilities.

[h2]Infinite Possibilities of Vehicle Customization[/h2]
The enjoyment of vehicle gameplay extends beyond progression. Vehicle customization should not be confined to fixed combinations of provided components. Our vision is that vehicle customization should inspire players to come up with imaginative ideas. Players can utilize various components such as chassis, engine, power systems, armor, weapons, and more to DIY their desired configurations and bring their ideas to life in the game. The unique and wonderful experiences derived from non-repetitive fun are what we envision for the vehicle customization gameplay.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/b5672f62ea7b319572a15bf2a2d616a333080a5e.png[/img]
(Note: The presented ideas are conceptual, and actual effects may vary in the game.)

Based on this concept, there will be numerous possibilities for vehicle appearances, such as a drill-equipped collection vehicle with melee capabilities, a spider-like mech with multiple mechanical legs, or a heavily armored tank that can take off with propulsion equipment. Customizing vehicles can be based on combat needs, amplifying specific strengths, or creating unconventional designs. Diverse component choices allow everyone to build their dream vehicles, and it's entirely up to the players.

In the future, the damage assessment of vehicle components will be independent. When components are damaged, they lose their intended functions, with varied impacts. For example, attacking outer armor does not damage the engine in the central position, a broken track does not affect turret rotation and barrel firing, and a blown tire may cause the vehicle to skid. These changes further increase the randomness of the combat process.

To reiterate, the above content is planned for gradual implementation in the second phase. With the opening of the creative workshop, we anticipate exploring additional vehicle gameplay possibilities. Even after the vehicle system matures, we plan to introduce diverse competitive game modes, such as racing events and skirmish events. For us, this goal will be long-term.

That concludes this development log. Remember not to miss out on more exciting information in the future. Please stay tuned!

notes.title: The Front Announcement Regarding New Anti-Cheat System
notes.notes:
We are committed to providing a healthy and fair gaming environment for all players. As part of the game's "infrastructure," the anti-cheat system has always been a priority for us.

Recently, we have received feedback from some players regarding their experience with the ACE anti-cheat system. This includes concerns about disruptions to the gaming process and data safety issues. While we have attempted adjustments and guidance to address these issues, it appears that we have not been able to fundamentally solve the problems, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

After careful consideration, we have decided to introduce a completely new and comprehensive anti-cheat system to replace the existing ACE system. Our team is currently in the testing phase, and once the testing is successful, we anticipate rolling out the new system to the official servers shortly.

Creating a healthy and fair gaming environment requires the collective effort of everyone. If you encounter cheating or hacking in-game, we encourage you to submit a support ticket for reporting. 

[url=https://thefront.zohodesk.com/portal/en/home]https://thefront.zohodesk.com/portal/en/home[/url]

We will expedite the testing of the new anti-cheat system and keep you updated on its progress.

Thank you all for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Dev Log 3: Expanding Vehicle Gameplay (11/20/2023)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are very excited to share with you our latest development log today.

In our last dev log, we addressed some frequently asked questions from our community. Since then, we have added the Warhammer Mobile Base, craftable skins, and have FOV and gamma options to the game. We are still hard at work implementing all of the features we have promised in our roadmap.

Since the launch of our Early Access version, players have used vehicles such as tanks and helicopters to attack each other’s bases and Imperial Army strongholds, experiencing all of the fun and exciting vehicular gameplay that The Front has to offer. During this process, we have been collecting feedback on the vehicles in the game. For instance, players have raised issues including the limitations of the vehicles, their lack of utility when raiding enemy bases, and their sameness in feel and appearance. This feedback has let us know how much potential has yet to be realized.

In this dev log, we would like to tell you more about the general development plan for expanded vehicle gameplay. We also invite you to leave comments, which will help us make further improvements.

Our initial plan is to add a vehicle assembly and forging factory (final named TBD), where players can use a variety of vehicle parts to assemble the vehicle of their choice. Later, these players will also be able to modify the vehicle by replacing and adjusting parts, and also give their vehicle a custom name, making vehicle gameplay more varied and interesting.

To this end, we are planning 6 major categories of vehicle parts, including chassis/fuselages, engines, mobility, armor, weapons, and auxiliary parts. These will provide a variety of different attributes to a vehicle. For instance, engine parts will boost max speeds and fuel consumption, and mobility parts will increase load limits. Our current plan is to implement part upgrading, forging, and reverse crafting. These three actions will give you power over the attributes of your vehicles.

We would also like to note that additional new content, new features, and more adjustments and optimizations are still in the works, as well. In order to ensure that these new vehicle features do not affect the previously established roadmap, we plan to complete work on them in two phases: in the first phase, will we complete development of basic functions and attribute values, which is expected to take 1-2 months; in the second phase, we will work on vehicle appearance changes that will take effect when players assemble and modify vehicles.

notes.title: Dev Log 2 (11/9/2023)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, since the release of Early Acess, we have been focusing on solving bugs, optimizing game functions, we understand that all you guys have given enough patience and tolerance to a game in the early access stage, in fact, whether it is the voice of support or skepticism, they are the best encouragement for us, thank you!

It's gratifying to see that after spending a lot of time and effort, the team and the game have changed a lot. After several updates and maintenance, we've resolved a lot of game issues and are on track with the Roadmap to release new content.

Recent update review:
Version 1.0.9 (10/25/2023):
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2285150/view/3707084947542060799

Version 1.0.10 (10/30/2023):
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2285150/view/3707084947560228476

Version 1.0.11 (11/3/2023):
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2285150/view/3805038873997628684

However, we know there are still some tricky issues left to be resolved. We have sorted them out and made plans, and we are now responding to some of the issues that you are most concerned about.

[h3]Helicopters will crash and explode if they are suddenly dropped while in flight, is there any improvement to this situation?[/h3]
[list]
[*] This situation has been adjusted on November 3, version 1.0.11 after the update: when driving a helicopter, if you encounter a drop, the helicopter will slowly land on the ground, and there will be no more crash and explosion.
[/list]

[h3]I've already got a lot of skins, when will I be able to use skins?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skins have been developed and will be added in the next version. When you use the workbench to create items, you will need to select the corresponding skin appearance (which you already have in your account warehouse).
[/list]

[h3]Are there any plans to support FOV adjustment?[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have completed development of support for adjusting FOV, which will also be implemented in the next version update.
[/list]

[h3]Are there any plans to add an option to adjust gamma?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yes, there will be support for adjusting brightness and FSR/DLSS/XESS settings in the next release.
[/list]

[h3]In PVP beacon protection, it is also possible to lure monsters to cause damages against other players, is this going to be adjusted?[/h3]
[list]
[*] It will be the same as PVE, during beacon protection time, NPCs can't deal damage to buildings within the beacon protection range.
[/list]

[h3]Regarding the buildings ownership, when the squad member who placed the beacon leaves, other people can't interact with the squad buildings within the range, are there any plans to make some changes to this setting?[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have no plans to change the way that buildings within the range of a space-time beacon belong to the beacon's owner for the time being. However, we are working on a squad impeachment function, so that if a squad member is not online for a long period of time, the other squad members can gain access to that member's permissions through impeachment.
[/list]

[h3]Can we increase the squad size limit?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yes, we have already included "increase squad size" in our development plan, but it will take some time.
[/list]

[h3]Can I repair my vehicle?[/h3]
[list]
[*] We plan to add vehicle repair factories in the near future, so players can drive their vehicles to the factories and have them repaired.
[/list]

[h3]Loot bag is stuck in a gap and can't be picked up after a character dies, is there any way around this?[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the future, we will add a feature that allows players to consume specified materials to retrieve props dropped after character death with the help of a workbench of some kind, but of course this operation will have a cooldown time limit.
[/list]

[h3]What measures will be taken against cheating?[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have zero tolerance for cheating, we have already released the first batch of banning announcements on November 2, and will release ban list from time to time, this work will be carried out for a long time. Meanwhile, we are continuing to strengthen and improve the protection mechanism in the game, to ensure a fair and healthy game environment is the ultimate goal.
[/list]

[h3]Recruited followers are currently limited in their functions, will special talents be added to followers in the future?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Currently, recruited followers have only one single function, but we are already working on expanding the talent system of followers, which will enhance their functions in manufacturing, traps, vehicles, and so on.  In addition, recruited followers may come with recipes for exclusive items (not unlocked through the tech tree), and these talents and recipes will be randomly assigned according to certain rules, and the relevant functions are currently under development.
[/list]

[h3]What will be the future development for PVE casual players?[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game plans to add a planting gene system, the most direct benefit of cultivating good genes is that it can increase crop yields, and at the same time, seeds with excellent genetic characteristics will be more resistant to cold and no longer be affected by the low temperatures of the snowy mountains, and the growth rate will be faster. However, the cultivation process requires more patience. In addition, the need for one-click planting will be fulfilled in the future, so planting will no longer be a laborious task.
[/list]

We will make regular updates to fix bugs, adjust game balance, and optimize server improvements. We have established dedicated [url=https://discord.com/channels/1061915520703668265/1161591348680474644]bugs report channel[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/channels/1061915520703668265/1163414955358425138]suggestion channel[/url] in Discord for you. If you encounter game problems or have any good ideas and suggestions, you are welcome to exchange feedback there!

We will continue to share the game's development plans and latest progress with all of you!

2. Fix the problems of terrains and game scenes, such as stuck points, cracks, materials, weather, lighting, resource floating and model collisions.
3. Fix the problem of after selecting "switch" in character advance mode does not take effect.
4. Fix the problem that the indestructible 1 hp territory flags.
5. Fix the problem that the use of explosives may cause the server to crash.

7. Fix the problem that logging trucks cannot collect some palm trees.
8. Fix the problem that the blimp does not show the loot box sometimes.
9. After server restart, it will no longer be necessary to reactivate the follower in the workbench.
10. Game balance adjustments, including the Annihilator sniper rifle, Molotov Cocktails, helicopters, and so on.
11. Other fixes and optimizations.

The actual update content is subject to the official announcement, and some urgent issues will be included in the update plan after they are resolved.

[h1]New game content[/h1]

Meanwhile, in order to ensure that players can have new experience at different stages, we are following the steps of the established roadmap, and these new game content will be available to you in the next two weeks.

1. Halloween event, which will reward you with limited-time items such as pumpkin helmets, pumpkin lamps, coffins and tombstones.
2. New power-ups, including the Extended Splitter (1 in 10) and Extended Coupler (10 in 1).
3. New character vehicle talents, including shortened manufacturing time, reduced vehicle fuel consumption/maintenance consumption/fall damage and other effects.
4. The buildable Warhammer Base Vehicle, which will be revealed in a live demo video in the near future!
5. New NPC: Flying Soldier, it can carry machine guns in the air to provide fire support for players.
6. Introducing the skin use function, and there will be several new skins, which can be obtained from the steam drop box in the game lobby.
7. Wiki has been added in several new languages, which can be viewed by pressing the [F1] key in the game, making it convenient for novice players to quickly understand the game.
8. NPC performance optimization, including better melee attack animations, tamed NPC will follow the player in a smoother speed. (We have planned to optimize the behavior of NPCs in the upcoming patches, their behavior will no longer be stiff and stagnant, and will have their own characteristics, this work will be carried out for a long time).

[h1]Zero tolerance for cheaters/hackers and we will continue to fight against it![/h1]

We have a zero tolerance for hackers/cheaters, we have organized an anti-cheat team to follow up all the cheater reports gathered from the players. We have permanently banned more than 300 cheating accounts, and will continue to do the same to all cheaters. The Front is committed to improving the in-game anti-cheat mechanism, to create a fair and healthy gaming environment for everyone.
If you find anything suspicious during the game, you can press [ESC] - [Feedback] to submit, Our customer service team will follow up the report and verify the situation with you.

We have created a [url=https://discord.com/channels/1061915520703668265/1163414955358425138][suggestion] channel[/url] in our Discord for player’s suggestions. If you are dissatisfied with the current situation and want to improve them, or you are looking for support for new features, or if you have your own ideas about the gameplay mode, you are welcome to speak freely here, and we will organize them in real time and answer them with regular replies.

For some of the high-quality suggestions, we will provide specific skins as a thank you gift when the skin feature is launched. Your suggestions are very important to us, and they will be an important reference for the future development of the game.

Steam crate drops will be available at launch. Players who play the game on Steam will receive crates after playing a certain amount of time.

[h1]ABOUT THE FRONT[/h1]

[b]Build your own shelter in a post-apocalyptic world[/b] — Unrestricted by terrain and unbound by ideas, there are hundreds of building components available to satisfy your imagination.

[b]Unique tower defense gameplay[/b] — Control the enemy’s routes and arrange traps and defensive turrets that can sense and auto-attack incoming enemy hordes, including wild monsters, bomb maniacs, stealthy assassins, flying soldiers, and more.

notes.notes: The Front is a "survival open-world crafting shooter" that promises a little bit of everything. It sets players up as resistance fighters who travel back in time to stop the rise of a tyrannical empire that used technology taken from mysterious artifacts to conquer the world. It sounds pretty straightforward as a sci-fi shooter setup, and not immediately terrible. But there are also zombies running around for some reason, and "exiles, thugs, and rebels" to deal with, tanks to drive and planes to fly, and even bases to build and defend "with tower defense-style traps." And that's without even mentioning the weather, which is also apparently pretty bad... Read more.
